control_profile.label: action
control_profile.rule: Canonical cross-platform input profile for playable runtime controls; Godot, web, Android, iOS, and Roblox adapters must read action names and bindings from this shard instead of hardcoding platform keys in gameplay code.

display_profile.label: playfield
display_profile.rule: Canonical playable display and world profile; gameplay code must read viewport, camera, tile size, and world tile dimensions from this shard instead of hardcoding playfield size.

ui_profile.label: ui
ui_profile.rule: Canonical source UI size and spacing profile; generated consumer bridge code must read icon and padding defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source UI constants.

gameplay_profile.label: gameplay
gameplay_profile.rule: Canonical playable gameplay defaults profile; runtime code must read unit bounds and builder range defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

construction_profile.label: construction
construction_profile.rule: Canonical playable construction defaults profile; runtime code must read builder speed, block build-time fallback, and deconstruction defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

block_profile.label: block
block_profile.rule: Canonical playable block defaults profile; runtime code must read Block boolean defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

turret_profile.label: turret
turret_profile.rule: Canonical playable turret defaults profile; runtime code must read turret reload, range, rotation, shoot cone, and recoil defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

bullet_profile.label: bullet
bullet_profile.rule: Canonical playable bullet defaults profile; runtime code must read BulletType and BasicBulletType numeric defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

unit_profile.label: unit
unit_profile.rule: Canonical playable unit defaults profile; runtime code must read UnitType numeric defaults from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

factory_profile.label: factory
factory_profile.rule: Canonical playable factory defaults profile; runtime code must read drill, block dump, and conveyor default factors from this shard instead of hardcoding source constants in gameplay code.

time_profile.label: time
time_profile.rule: Canonical Arc time conversion profile; runtime code must read tick-rate conversion from this shard instead of hardcoding Time.toSeconds in gameplay code.

math_profile.label: math
math_profile.rule: Canonical Arc math and Rand constants profile; runtime code must read PI, sine lookup, and Rand long normalization/hash constants from this shard instead of hardcoding Arc values in gameplay code.
